sqlMap.select: SELECT UNIT_PRICE , CONTRACT_NO , CONTRACT_SEQ , AGENT FROM icomcqdt WHERE buyer = 'KRYUHAG001' and below_comorg_code = #BUYER# and buyer_item_no = #BUYER_ITEM_NO# and status != 'D'

SELECT TO_CHAR(COUNT(*)) AS TOT_CNT, TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(ITEM_AMT),0)) AS TOT_AMT, TO_CHAR(COUNT(DECODE(IF_FLAG,'E','X',NULL))) AS ERR_CNT, TO_CHAR(COUNT(DECODE(STATUS, 'D','D',NULL))) AS DEL_CNT FROM IF_PRDT WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND LEGACY_PR_NO = #LEGACY_PR_NO# AND REVISION = #REVISION#
sqlMap.update: MERGE INTO IF_PROGRESS A USING ( SELECT NVL(TRIM(#BUYER#), ' ') AS BUYER, #GUBUN# AS GUBUN, NVL(TRIM(#LEGACY_NO#), ' ') AS LEGACY_NO, NVL(TRIM(#REVISION#), ' ') AS REVISION FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.GUBUN = B.GUBUN AND A.LEGACY_NO = B.LEGACY_NO AND A.REVISION = B.REVISION ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( BUYER, GUBUN, LEGACY_NO, REVISION, STATUS, IF_FLAG, TOT_CNT, TOT_AMT, ERR_CNT, ERR_MSG, REMARK, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, ADD_DATE ) VALUES ( NVL(TRIM(#BUYER#), ' '), #GUBUN#, NVL(TRIM(#LEGACY_NO#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#REVISION#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#STATUS#), ' '), NVL(#IF_FLAG#, ' '), NVL(#TOT_CNT#, 0), NVL(#TOT_AMT#, 0), NVL(#ERR_CNT#, 0), NVL(TRIM(#ERR_MSG#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#REMARK#), ' '), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET STATUS = NVL(TRIM(#STATUS#),' '), IF_FLAG = NVL(TRIM(#IF_FLAG#),' '), TOT_CNT = NVL(#TOT_CNT#,0), ERR_CNT = NVL(#ERR_CNT#,0), ERR_MSG = NVL(TRIM(#ERR_MSG#),' '), REMARK = NVL(TRIM(#REMARK#),' '), CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS')

MERGE INTO IF_PRDT A USING ( SELECT NVL(TRIM(#BUYER#), ' ') AS BUYER, NVL(TRIM(#LEGACY_PR_NO#), ' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, NVL(TRIM(#LEGACY_PR_SEQ#), ' ') AS LEGACY_PR_SEQ, NVL(TRIM(#REVISION#), ' ') AS REVISION FROM DUAL ) B ON ( 1=1 AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.LEGACY_PR_NO = B.LEGACY_PR_NO AND A.LEGACY_PR_SEQ = B.LEGACY_PR_SEQ AND A.REVISION = B.REVISION ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( BUYER, LEGACY_PR_NO, LEGACY_PR_SEQ, REVISION, STATUS, BUYER_ITEM_NO, UNIT_PRICE, ITEM_QTY, ITEM_AMT, RD_DATE, REQ_USER_ID, REQ_USER_NAME, NOTE, ADD_DATE, PLANT, CREATE_DATE, CREATE_TIME, IF_DATE, IF_TIME, FILE_NAME, IF_FLAG, ERROR_MSG ) VALUES ( NVL(TRIM(#BUYER#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#LEGACY_PR_NO#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#LEGACY_PR_SEQ#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#REVISION#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#STATUS#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#BUYER_ITEM_NO#), ' '), NVL( #UNIT_PRICE#, 0), NVL( #ITEM_QTY#, 0), NVL( #ITEM_AMT#, 0), NVL(TRIM(#RD_DATE#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#REQ_USER_ID#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#REQ_USER_NAME#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#NOTE#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#ADD_DATE#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#PLANT#), ' '), NVL(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), ' '), NVL(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), ' '), NVL(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), ' '), NVL(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#FILE_NAME#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#IF_FLAG#), ' '), NVL(TRIM(#ERROR_MSG#), ' ') ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET STATUS = NVL(TRIM(#STATUS#), ' '), BUYER_ITEM_NO = NVL(TRIM(#BUYER_ITEM_NO#), ' '), UNIT_PRICE = NVL( #UNIT_PRICE#, 0), ITEM_QTY = NVL( #ITEM_QTY#, 0), ITEM_AMT = NVL( #ITEM_AMT#, 0), RD_DATE = NVL(TRIM(#RD_DATE#), ' '), REQ_USER_ID = NVL(TRIM(#REQ_USER_ID#), ' '), REQ_USER_NAME = NVL(TRIM(#REQ_USER_NAME#), ' '), NOTE = NVL(TRIM(#NOTE#), ' '), ADD_DATE = NVL(TRIM(#ADD_DATE#), ' '), PLANT = NVL(TRIM(#PLANT#), ' '), FILE_NAME = NVL(TRIM(#FILE_NAME#), ' '), IF_FLAG = NVL(TRIM(#IF_FLAG#), ' '), IF_DATE = NVL(TRIM(#IF_DATE#), ' '), IF_TIME = NVL(TRIM(#IF_TIME#), ' '), ERROR_MSG = NVL(TRIM(#ERROR_MSG#), ' ')
